note: Gate 9 mutant set: two mutants per spec boundary. Each 'search' must match exactly once in 'file'; mutate.py aborts otherwise. Newlines are normalized to the target file's own line ending before matching.

mutants.description: Loosen the concept path regex so a '/' is legal inside the slug: knowledge/concepts/nested/note.md would be accepted.
Drop the knowledge/concepts/ prefix and the start anchor, so any traversal or absolute path ending in a lowercase .md name (../escape.md, C:/absolute.md) is accepted.
Refuse a directive only on Direction.In, so a directive in the model's compile output (Direction.Out) is no longer refused.
mutants.search: return new GateResult(cleaned, findings, directive && component == ComponentKind.Compile);
mutants.replace: return new GateResult(cleaned, findings, directive && component == ComponentKind.Compile && direction == Direction.In);

mutants.description: Remove the refusal entirely: the directive finding is still reported but the run is never quarantined.
mutants.search: return new GateResult(cleaned, findings, directive && component == ComponentKind.Compile);

mutants.description: Drop CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR from the child environment, so the isolated claude -p call inherits the user's own config, hooks and skills.
Run the child process with the vault itself as its working directory instead of a directory outside the vault.
